title: Thundertree · Area 10 · Town square

sourceRecords.title: Thundertree 10 · Town square
read: A leaning warrior statue watches over a square almost swallowed by brush. Paths leave in several directions.

The warrior's pose remains visible despite the statue's lean, and the paths offer several different ways to leave the square. You can study the carving, check your bearings against the surrounding ruins, or choose the next approach with the whole group in sight.

brief: Thundertree town square swallowed in brush, multiple dirt paths branch around a leaning warrior statue. Human hero holds a spear and shield, ordinary weathered stone. No readable nameplate, magical giant statue or living townspeople. Background ruined cottages, daylight.
